title: Play AC Online talk pools file
description: Villager line pools. On an ordinary talk where no script said a line, a villager says at most one data line a day, then their own hello. A special talk never uses a pool. Today's calendar lines come first. Otherwise the most specific matching pools are used: this villager, else this personality, else everyone. When several mods have pools that match, their lines are put together and one is picked. It is not always the first mod's. The game keeps which villagers had their line today per town with the save, so restarting the game does not make them say one again. Either scope. Pools run in The City too. Generated from the mod API spec (https://playaconline.com/schemas/api.json). Do not edit by hand. Reference: https://playaconline.com/modding/reference/files/

villager.description: A villager's name, any case. Not with personality.

chance.description: Days in 100 the pool speaks to a villager. Default 100.

items.description: A villager line: 1 to 160 characters, at most 3 line breaks.
